description:
Our member, Rtn. Diago Dsouza attended a club meeting at Rotary Club de Monaco, in Monaco a sovereign near France. He attended this meeting along with his son, Cliffowen Dsouza.

A productive meeting was held with Rotary Club de Monaco to discuss potential collaborations in education and healthcare. The club expressed keen interest and invited project proposals for future collaboration.
